# Recorded by bbb-conform record. Review it with bbb-conform review before committing.
case isMeetingRunning.lifecycle.after-end
target fake

== step 1: call create
status 200
header Cache-Control no-cache
header Content-Type text/xml;charset=utf-8
body xml
/response/returncode "SUCCESS"
/response/meetingID "${uid}"
/response/internalMeetingID "<sha1(meetingID)>-<time>"
/response/attendeePW "<random>"
/response/moderatorPW "<random>"
/response/createTime "<time>"
/response/messageKey
/response/message

== step 2: call end
status 200
header Cache-Control no-cache
header Content-Type text/xml;charset=utf-8
body xml
/response/returncode "SUCCESS"
/response/messageKey "sentEndMeetingRequest"
/response/message "A request to end the meeting was sent.  Please wait a few seconds, and then use the getMeetingInfo or isMeetingRunning API calls to verify that it was ended."

== step 4: call isMeetingRunning
status 200
header Cache-Control no-cache
header Content-Type text/xml;charset=utf-8
body xml
/response/returncode "SUCCESS"
/response/running "false"
